name: Carrera (eyewear)
verdict: Carrera eyewear is a Safilo Group house brand; Safilo is Milan-listed, with HAL Holding's Multibrands Italy at 49.8%. Nothing found.
note: Official Partner of the Ducati Lenovo Team: on Ducati's partner page its logo, which links to carreraworld.com, stands under 'Official Partners' with the line 'Sunglasses and optical frames since 1956' (Wayback Machine captures of 23 May and 18 Sep 2026). Rating note (2026-09-30): Carrera is one of Safilo Group's home brands; Safilo is listed in Milan and its reference shareholder is Multibrands Italy B.V., a subsidiary of HAL Holding N.V., with 49.8% (safilo-hal-ownership). No state or state-fund shareholder named.
